# Employee

## Summary
Extends PersonBase with role, department, startDate (onboarding), status (onboarding | active | offboarded), salary, and a self-referential `manager` link. `tenure` is a computed DurationField in days since startDate.

## Import
```ts
import { Employee } from '../trt-employee';
```

## Usage
```ts
@field manager = linksTo(() => Employee);
```
The org-chart tree is built from the manager edges via `buildOrgTree` in `utils/index`.

## Template Usage
Has isolated (profile with facts grid) and fitted (avatar + name + role row) views.

**Non-goals:** payroll/benefits detail; multi-manager or dotted-line reporting (single `manager` edge only); offboarding workflow.
